text: {"lessons":["My account has fallen about 10% from Period 1 despite several quiet months, so I should review exposure and risk periodically rather than assume that doing nothing is always prudent.","The early gains from selling B and C felt rewarding, but price relative to my average cost alone is not a sound reason to sell; use forward-looking prospects and a consistent plan.","Monthly moves have been uneven and do not predict what comes next, so I should avoid reacting to short-term noise and make measured decisions that fit my overall portfolio."]}
